blocks.text: With the holiday rush already underway by mid-November, savvy shoppers are getting an early start on planning gift lists, preparing their homes, and seeking meaningful purchases well before December. This 11.11, Lazada Philippines invites the savviest of Filipino shoppers to start Christmas right with quality finds from trusted global brands at its 11.11 Biggest Sale of the Year, running from 8 PM on November 6 to November 13, 2026.
